mapper.insert: INSERT INTO itinerary_items ( trip_day_id, place_id, item_type, title, start_time, end_time, sort_order, memo, estimated_cost, currency_code, source ) VALUES ( #{tripDayId}, #{placeId}, #{itemType}, #{title}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{sortOrder}, #{memo}, #{estimatedCost}, COALESCE(#{currencyCode}, 'KRW'), COALESCE(#{source}, 'MANUAL') )
mapper.update: UPDATE itinerary_items SET place_id = #{placeId}, item_type = #{itemType}, title = #{title}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, memo = #{memo}, estimated_cost = #{estimatedCost}, currency_code = #{currencyCode}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE itinerary_item_id = #{itineraryItemId}
